result.markdown:
If you’re looking for **medical negligence lawyers in Hobart**, I’d shortlist firms based on demonstrated medical-negligence experience rather than general Google ratings alone. There isn’t an objective “#1” lawyer, but these stand out from my search:

1. **Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers** — A strong specialist option. Their Hobart practice focuses on personal injury, including medical negligence, and Phil Schubert is identified as an Accredited Specialist Personal Injury Lawyer. [www.lawyer.com.au](https://www.lawyer.com.au/medical-lawyers-in-hobart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
2. **LHD Lawyers Hobart** — Another established personal-injury practice that appears in Hobart medical-malpractice rankings. [bestinau.com.au](https://bestinau.com.au/medical-malpractice-lawyers-hobart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
3. **Slater and Gordon Lawyers Hobart** — Particularly worth considering if you want a large national firm with a dedicated medical-negligence practice. Its Hobart team specifically handles misdiagnosis, surgical errors, birth injuries, medication errors and other medical-negligence claims. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/medical-negligence-law/medical-negligence-lawyers-in-hobart?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
4. **Wallace Wilkinson & Webster** — An established Hobart firm that has also been listed among the city's medical-malpractice practices. [bestinau.com.au](https://bestinau.com.au/medical-malpractice-lawyers-hobart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
5. **Monaco Solicitors** — Their Hobart medical-negligence team specifically lists **Sachini Amarasinghe, Iain Miller, Byron Dickson and Nicole Kelly** as lawyers handling medical-negligence matters. [monacosolicitors.com.au](https://monacosolicitors.com.au/service/medical-negligence-lawyers-in-hobart-tasmania/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My pick for where to start

For a **serious medical-negligence claim**, I'd get initial opinions from **Blumers, Slater & Gordon and Monaco** and compare:

- the individual solicitor who will actually run your case;
- their recent experience with cases similar to yours;
- whether they will obtain independent medical expert evidence;
- their **no-win-no-fee terms and disbursements**;
- likely limitation/time-bar issues; and
- what happens if the matter proceeds to court.

This is particularly important because medical-negligence cases generally require strong independent medical evidence, and Tasmania has specific rules governing negligence claims. [www.hobartlegal.org.au](https://www.hobartlegal.org.au/handbook/medical-treatment-and-medical-products/medical-treatment/medical-negligence/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. misdiagnosis, surgical error, delayed diagnosis, birth injury, medication error)** and roughly **when it happened**, I can narrow this down to the **3 best Hobart lawyers for that particular type of claim**, including their experience, reviews, fees/no-win-no-fee arrangements and contact details.
